_description: Primus experiment YAML across SLURM nodes; each node runs primus-cli direct inside the model container
_use_case: Multi-node Primus pretrain (Megatron/TorchTitan) with madengine scheduling and perf.csv collection
_note: Primus picks the NIC/HCA and RCCL tuning itself (runner/helpers/envs/base_env.sh), so the multi-node profile's NCCL_IB_DISABLE/NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME/HSA_ENABLE_SDMA are not exported for this launcher. Set them in env_vars to force a value.
